description: This file defines the class `Thing3ValuePredicateVisitor`, a visitor implementing criteria evaluation logic specifically for partial 'Thing' objects, considering unknown fields. It provides methods to evaluate logical combinations (AND, OR, NOR), handle existence checks, field-based predicates, and internal logic for three-valued logic (TRUE, FALSE, UNKNOWN). This class is used to assess whether a criteria could be true for a partial object within a specific context, likely used in query or filtering operations in the system.

classes.name: Thing3ValuePredicateVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class that evaluates criteria against partial 'Thing' objects, determining whether the criteria could be true considering unknown fields.

classes.name: Trilean
classes.description: An enum representing a three-valued logic (TRUE, FALSE, UNKNOWN) used for partial evaluation of criteria.

methods.name: canBeTrue
methods.description: Static method to evaluate if a given criteria could be true for a specific partial 'Thing', considering a set of unknown fields.

methods.name: visitAnd
methods.description: Evaluates a logical AND of multiple criteria functions over a 'Thing', returning a combined Trilean result.

methods.name: visitAny
methods.description: Evaluates a criteria that always returns true (as a disjunction of zero or more criteria).

methods.name: visitExists
methods.description: Evaluates existence of a field expression in a 'Thing', considering unknown fields, returning Trilean value.

methods.name: visitField
methods.description: Evaluates a field predicate against a 'Thing', considering unknown fields, returning Trilean.

methods.name: visitNor
methods.description: Evaluates the negation of a disjunction of criteria functions.

methods.name: visitOr
methods.description: Evaluates a disjunction (OR) of multiple criteria functions over a 'Thing'.

methods.name: isUnknownField
methods.description: Checks if a given field expression corresponds to an unknown field based on the set of unknown fields.

methods.name: GetJsonPointer
methods.description: A visitor class that extracts the JsonPointer from a FieldExpression.

methods.name: lift
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to a corresponding Trilean value.

methods.name: not
methods.description: Negates a Trilean value following Kleene logic.

methods.name: or
methods.description: Computes the logical OR of two Trilean values.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Computes the logical AND of two Trilean values.
